conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Long'er's fist suddenly clenches tightly, the surrounding space groaning under unbearable strain. Color recedes like a tide—the tender glow of Spring Energy, the luster of the bluestone steps, even the cold light flowing on Youmu's blade—all freeze into black and white like an old silent film. Immediately after, this remaining contrast of light and dark is swallowed by surging ink, complete darkness enveloping everything. In this abyss that devours light, only Long'er's low voice echoes: "Have you heard of black holes?" As he speaks, countless stars suddenly burst forth in the darkness, swirling frantically around everyone, finally intertwining into a massive ∞ symbol. The symbol pulsates as if alive, abruptly erupting with a dazzling torrent of particles, rushing towards Youmu like a breached galaxy. Can... this really be blocked... Even so, Youmu merely grits her teeth, both swords drawn, her figure becoming a silver flash within the particle storm. "Spell Card Two: Mind's Eye Delusion Slash!" Her shout resonates with the ringing of her blades, each swing precisely severing a stream of particles. Scattered energy fragments explode around her, like a star-dust woven haori draped over her. But the wound on her left shoulder heaves violently with each swing, the pain making the girl frown. The moment the particle torrent collides with her sword's perimeter, a spray of blood flowers blooms from the girl's left shoulder. She seems unaware, the trajectories of her twin blades growing increasingly fierce. Every splattered drop of blood freezes into ice crystals in the darkness, only to be swept into crimson mist by the next sword wind. The explosive sounds of the tachi shattering particles are dense as a downpour, and in the gaps of this metallic storm, one can hear her suppressed panting and the light sound of blood droplets hitting the stone steps—tap, tap, like a death-ticking second hand. One slash, two slashes, in the night, only silver-white sword light flashes. A thousand slashes, ten thousand slashes, the silver-white sword light illuminates the very night. The net woven by sword light continuously contracts, each parry tearing the shoulder wound deeper. As the black hole begins to collapse, she charges forward against the galaxy-like torrent, blood-stained silver hair dancing wildly in the particle storm. Until the final moment, when that particle beam pierces her defense and strikes her chest, you finally see she is already drenched in blood. In the tremor of the tachi leaving her hand and embedding into the stone steps, she kneels on one knee, using blood-stained fingers to desperately press against the ground, preventing herself from completely collapsing. On the steps, the girl kneels, breathing heavily. Behind her are the two tachi that left her hand. "Huff... huff..." It seems... I'm about to fail in my duty. The gardener looks at the gate to the Netherworld behind her. And at the enemies before her. Even knowing that Lady Yuyuko's actions are wrong...

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Youmu's blood-stained figure suddenly blurs, the trajectories of her tachi slash leave scorching silver traces in the air. The moment Future Eternity Slash is unleashed, the Spring Energy light flow along the entire staircase is severed. Before the blade arrives, the fierce sword pressure has already cracked the stone slabs beneath your feet. Youmu's figure instantly blurs at the boundary between motion and stillness; she maintains her sheathing stance, yet seven solidified afterimages simultaneously bloom like shattered mirrors. Each afterimage depicts a different stage of the slash: drawing, swinging, charging, spinning... as if tearing the entire sword technique's timeline into seven sharp fragments. The initial silver arc still trembles in the air, subsequent slashes have already sprouted from the void like vines, they entwine the Spring Energy's flowing light, cutting the scattered cherry petals into finer crystals. And the target of this sword intent is, ahead, the nearest one to herself—Lina. Before Lina's retreating heel even touches the ground, three beams of blade light have already intertwined like thorns at her landing point as if foretold; when she raises her hand to block, the tachi's phantom has already pierced through the gaps in her defense, blooming seven neat cuts on her sleeve—each precisely slicing the fabric without harming the skin. Only when the silver glint Youmu flicks from her blade clatters against the stone steps do you realize with shock that what fills the sky are not cherry blossoms, but moonlight cut into petal shapes. The Netherworld plants behind her within ten zhang still maintain their complete forms, but every leaf reflects the afterimage of the slash just performed; time itself seems insignificant under this strike.
